name: Godly Promotion
source:
A lowly office worker is murdered in his own home, and with no one to mourn him is trapped in the 'Boundary Between Worlds'- coming into contact with a being known as Lafayette -Origin-. Now he has to learn how to become the next God of Boundaries and decide the fate of those who also end up in this very space. 

[From [url=https://deathhunterashi.itch.io/godly-promotion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名卑微的办公室职员在自己的家中被谋杀，没有人哀悼他，他被困在“世界之间的边界”中——与一个被称为拉斐特-起源-的存在接触。现在他必须学习如何成为下一个界之神，并决定那些最终也在这个空间里的人的命运。

[来自[url=https://deathhunterashi.itch.io/godly-promotion]Itch.io[/url]]
